newsitem.title: USA: NYSEG says to review dividend, shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: NYSEG says to review dividend, shr buyback.

text.p: New York State Electric & Gas Corp, which is fighting a hostile takeover attempt by CalEnergy Co Inc, has told shareholders it will soon review its dividend and stock buyback policy.
The company recently struck an agreement with state regulators that it said will remove some uncertainty surrounding the company's share price and will provide greater frlexibility for expansion.

"We anticipate that the board of directors will be in a position shortly to review the dividend policy in its entirety, together with its overall view on uses of the company's cash, including the buyback of additional common shares," Chief Executivce Wesley von Schack wrote in an Aug. 8 letter to shareholders.

"I don't want to prejudge what actions the board might take, but the agreement in principle is clearly positive in terms of providing an overall framework for planning the company's needs for cash, and its ability to generate cash," he wrote.
The company now has a quarterly dividend of $0.35 per share.
